title: Distribution Enforcement via Random Probe: Active Distributional Constraints for Robust Deep Learning

contributions.purpose: 训练中主动强制隐空间分布约束而非被动等其涌现
contributions.mechanism: DERP 框架:随机低维投影统计检验+可微统计损失并入反向传播+自适应分布微调
contributions.evaluation: CelebA KS 距离 0.037 vs Standard VAE 0.057(64D 隐空间);计算开销仅 0-4%
contributions.source_quote: Active Distributional Enforcement: First framework to actively optimize distributional properties during training rather than hoping they emerge passively

contributions.purpose: 高维分布可高效统计验证
contributions.mechanism: 基于 Cramer-Wold 定理的随机投影+改良 KS 距离(用平均偏差替代最大偏差得平滑梯度)
contributions.evaluation: 0-4% 训练时间开销;CelebA 上 DERP 2403.9→3186.6s,CIFAR 上部分设置反而更快
contributions.source_quote: Efficient High-Dimensional Testing: Random projection-based approach enabling statistical verification in high-dimensional spaces with minimal computational overhead

contributions.purpose: 实证 DERP 分布合规改善与主动强制
contributions.mechanism: CIFAR-10(4D)与 CelebA(64D)上 VAE 与 β-VAE 基线对比
contributions.evaluation: CelebA KS 0.037(优于 0.057-0.108);但 CIFAR eval KS 0.138/0.151 反劣于 β-VAE(0.5) 的 0.087;Cohen's d=-0.686
contributions.source_quote: Empirical Validation: Evidence of improved distributional compliance (KS distance 0.037 vs 0.057 on CelebA) and unique active enforcement across CIFAR-10 and CelebA datasets

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our key insight extends beyond classical statistical testing: Modified Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance using average rather than maximum deviation provides smoother gradients for backpropagation while maintaining statistical power.
DERP-VAE extends standard VAE architecture with distributional enforcement

notes: 负结果/trade-off:方法只在 CelebA 的 eval KS(0.037 vs 0.057)获胜;在 CIFAR-10 上 DERP eval KS 0.138/0.151 反而劣于 β-VAE(0.5) 的 0.087,即主张的'分布强制'未转化为更好的评测 KS。数据红旗:表格数字雷同——DERP 3-probe 与 5-probe 的 Train KS 均为 0.322、Cohen's d 均为 -0.686(两种探针数结果完全相同,可疑);CIFAR-10 分类准确率所有模型挤在 25.2%-26.3%(近乎均匀,像与方法无关的固定值)。全文措辞高度对冲('in some cases''suggesting''promising''potential')。Figure 1/2 为'comprehensive results visualization'占位式描述。贡献以 conclusion 的 4 条列表为准(此处取核心 3 条 method/method/finding)。
